title: The Doubling Crystal of the Hollow Vault
story: Deep in a crypt-vault lit by cold green glow, Grellowspar the Mirror-Crystal grows every time a blade strikes it: one sharp tap and every shard becomes two. The guards struck it three times before they fled, and it now fills half the room. Mr 6 sheathes his sword and sits down with chalk — he intends to win this one by NOT swinging.
question: Grellowspar started as 7 shards, and each strike doubles the number of shards. The guards struck it 3 times. If Mr 6 instead sings the Stilling Verse, which removes exactly 23 shards without any doubling, how many shards are left?
solution: Three strikes doubled the shards three times: 7 x 2 x 2 x 2 = 56 shards.
The Stilling Verse removes 23 of them: 56 - 23 = 33.
praise: Doubling three times was exactly right — the last step was taking the Stilling Verse's 23 shards away from that total.
hint: Double the 7 shards once for each strike (three times in all) before you subtract anything.
victory: Mr 6 hummed the Stilling Verse while politely keeping his sword in its scabbard, and Grellowspar shrank to a glittering 33 shards — small enough to fit in a hat, and far too embarrassed to double again.
imagePrompt: A towering cluster of green-glowing mirror crystals filling a stone crypt vault, each facet reflecting a tiny numeral-six knight who sits cross-legged on the floor singing instead of swinging, chalk numbers scrawled across the flagstones.
